answer.text: 2025年双十一（11月1日至11日），订单数为 1,364 单。

queries.title: 订单数
queries.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-11'
LIMIT 1000
queries.executed_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    channel,
    customer_id,
    discount_amount,
    gross_amount,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders
) AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-11'
LIMIT 1000
